// Review check fixture. Plain text: never imported, built or deployed.
interface Env { DB: D1Database }

export async function publicEvent(eventId: string, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
  const row = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ?1 AND published = 1')
    .bind(eventId)
    .first<Record<string, unknown>>();
  if (!row) return new Response('not found', { status: 404 });
  return Response.json({ ...row, url: `/e/${eventId}` });
}
